label: Estimated Russian Military Casualties (KIA+WIA)
contestNote: Russian MoD does not publish figures; independent Russian estimates suggest 100,000–200,000 KIA; UK/Ukraine figures are higher. Ukrainian General Staff: ~1,482,150 as of Aug 27 (~+1,400 in the latest 24h). Zelensky (Aug 11): Russia sustained ~225,500 losses in 2026 alone (131,000 killed, 93,000 wounded) against only ~221,000 recruited — losses now outpacing recruitment, feeding assessments of a coming mobilization wave. Kyiv Independent: July 2026 was Russia's highest-loss month of the year (42,000+). Independent Mediazona/Meduza research confirmed 352,000+ Russian men ages 18-59 killed via public records — considered a significant undercount. Netherlands MIVD (April 2026): ~1.2 million permanent Russian losses, 500,000+ dead.
delta: ~+1,400 in latest 24h (Aug 27, 2026 per Ukraine General Staff)

label: Confirmed Ukrainian Civilian Deaths (UN)
source: UN Human Rights Monitoring Mission Ukraine (as of Aug 14, 2026)
contestNote: UN figure of 16,874 killed (incl. 820 children) and 51,273 wounded (incl. 3,126 children) since Feb 24, 2022 represents confirmed documented casualties; actual toll estimated significantly higher by independent analysts. July 2026 was the deadliest month for Ukrainian civilians since the first weeks of the invasion — 437 killed, 2,610 wounded, up 70% year-on-year.
